values.note: Every site has water and 50-amp electric; only 4 (sites 041A, 100, 101 and 102) also have sewer.

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232727 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20): all 100 catalogued sites Electricity Hookup 50 and Water Hookup Yes; Sewer Hookup Y on 041A, 100, 101, 102 + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232727 (amenity 'Water Hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 102 public sites plus 2 park-attendant sites; 23 pull-through. Listed vehicle lengths 16-62 ft, most 30-45. Northernmost sites are on the steepest terrain. One wheeled camping unit per site, parked on the impact pad; up to 10 campers per site.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232727 ('2 Park Attendant campsites, 102 public campsites'; 'the northernmost campsites being located on the steepest terrain'; notices on one wheeled unit and 10 campers) + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232727 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20) (Max Vehicle Length 16-62; Driveway Entry Pull-through 23), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232727 ('5 comfort stations with showers, 2 dump stations'; amenities Flush Toilets, Showers, Dump Station), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Run by the Corps' Hartwell Project with park attendants. Reservable on recreation.gov up to the day of arrival; one site (041A) is not reservable online. 14 nights in any 30 days. Gate locked 10 pm-7 am, so check in before 10 pm; check-in 3 pm, check-out 2 pm. Very high occupancy all year.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232727 (rules: maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days', reservationCutOff 0 days, minConsecutiveStay 1; notices on the gate, check-in/out and the 14-day limit; 'very high occupancy rates throughout the year') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232727 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20) (site 041A reservable false), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 2026 Peak Season (all year): $36 for the two 'RV Electric' sites, $38 for a standard water/electric site; the table also carries unnamed site rates of $42 and coded STANDARD ELECTRIC rates of $36, $44 and $76.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232727/rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31: 'PeakRV ELECTRIC' 36, 'PeakSTANDARD ELECTRIC' 38, two unnamed rates 42, coded STANDARD ELECTRIC rates 36, 44, 76), read 2026-10-21

note: USACE (Savannah District) campground on the SC side of Hartwell Lake near Pendleton, five miles from Clemson; swim beach. Many sites reported lakefront. --Claude
summary: Corps-operated (Hartwell Project). Confirmed $36-42 (2026), 50 A + water at every site, 102 sites to 62 ft, showers/flush toilets/dump, reservable on recreation.gov; sewer now noted as only 4 sites; added year-round season (Corps Hartwell camping page), 23 pull-throughs, 14-night limit, check-in rules. Note trimmed of field facts. Not stated: booking window, senior-pass acceptance (discounts left inherited).
